name: thematthub
description: Skills for Claude Code from real project work: writing, document export, publishing repositories, shareable web pages, presentations, simulation studies, plant data and LLM integration.

plugins.name: thematthub-writing-toolkit
plugins.description: Write texts a reader can follow without the author: handbooks, documentation sites, research papers, Italian texts, competitor analyses.

plugins.name: thematthub-repo-publishing
plugins.description: Turn a private repository into a safe public release, and cut versioned releases with draft notes.

plugins.name: thematthub-web-pages
plugins.description: Build shareable HTML pages (dashboards, viewers, monitors, reports) and choose interface colours that are validated instead of eyeballed.

plugins.name: thematthub-docs-export
plugins.description: Export a project's markdown documentation to Word and PDF, with your own templates and rendered Mermaid diagrams. The script is written for Windows.

plugins.name: thematthub-plant-data
plugins.description: Connect apps and simulations to live plant data (OPC UA, MQTT, MES, SQL) without leaking credentials or sending unsafe commands.

plugins.name: thematthub-llm-integration
plugins.description: Add language-model calls (Claude, OpenAI, Ollama, LM Studio) to an app, with reliable JSON output and guidance on choosing a local model.

plugins.name: thematthub-decks
plugins.description: Make presentations: brief and structure by kind, design in Claude Slides, finish and edit natively in PowerPoint, build on company templates. The PowerPoint steps need Windows with desktop PowerPoint.

plugins.name: thematthub-naga
plugins.description: Run a simulation study for a capacity or what-if decision (how many machines, staff or docks; will a change cope with demand) with the Naga engine. Needs the engine installed: pip install "nagasim[mcp]".
